description_en: Updates the information of an existing item on the platform
description_zh: 用于更新平台内已存在的商品信息
kebab_example: aliyun agentretailvision update-product --item-unique-id ITEM_001 --platform-item-id PLAT_001 --image-title '可口可乐330ml' --main-image https://img.example.com/item1.jpg --multi-view-images Angle=0 Url=https://nova-tems.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/crop/33dfc602-c9a4-11f0-ac99-ee21a901d6ec.png0OSSAccessKeyId=0000_Expires=1764058353_Signature=0000 --extra-images https://img.example.com/item1.jpg --device-id DEVICE_001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProduct

parameters.help_en: The business-side item ID, which is unique within the same business party
parameters.help_zh: 业务方商品ID，同一业务方下唯一
parameters.name: item_unique_id

parameters.help_en: The platform item ID, which is globally unique
parameters.name: platform_item_id

parameters.help_en: The list of main image URLs for the item. At least one image is required
parameters.help_zh: 商品主图图片URL列表，至少1张
parameters.name: main_image

fields.help_en:
The digital human angle.

0: Front, the default angle.
1: Left 30 degrees.
2: Right 30 degrees.

For a preview of each angle, refer to 3D Digital Human Video Synthesis User Guide (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/447834.html#a989eb5075t9y)
fields.help_zh:
数字人角度

0: 正面，默认角度
1: 左侧30度
2: 右侧30度

具体每个角度的效果预览可以参考：3D数字人视频合成使用指南 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/447834.html#a989eb5075t9y)
fields.name: angle
